reviews.title: Perfect low-profile cooler for Mini-ITX TrueNAS build - quiet and efficient
reviews.comment:
This little CPU cooler was perfect for my Mini-ITX TrueNAS home server build. I needed a small, low-profile cooler to fit in a tight case, and this was exactly what I needed. It's rated for 150W TDP and handles my 65 watt TDP 8600K processor with no problem. Even under load, my CPU temps are perfectly acceptable.
Installation:
Easy to install with clear instructions and all the necessary hardware included for both Intel and AMD platforms. The mounting system uses nuts on the backplate, so make sure they're tightened evenly to avoid any issues. Installation took just a few minutes following the included guide or the manufacturer's installation video.
Performance:
This 53mm height cooler combines a 92mm PWM fan with 4 pure copper heat pipes and a pure copper base. The AGHP 3.0 technology handles both horizontal and vertical mounting orientations well. CPU temps stay in check even during sustained loads, and the cooler runs quietly. The fan noise level is just 22.4dB at max, which is whisper quiet for a home server running 24/7.
Build quality:
Well constructed with aluminum fins, copper heat pipes, and a sturdy mounting bracket. The white color looks clean and professional. The included thermal paste works fine, though you can always use your own if you prefer. The TL-9015W slim PWM fan is reliable and adjustable via fan curve settings.
Who it's for:
Ideal if you're building a Mini-ITX system, NAS, HTPC, or any small form factor build where clearance is limited and you need a low-profile cooler that can handle up to 150W TDP. Great for home servers, media PCs, or compact gaming builds with mid-range CPUs.
Verdict:
Extremely reasonable price for a quality low-profile cooler. It looks good, runs quiet, and keeps temps in check. If you need a low-profile cooler for a small build, this works perfectly. Would definitely buy again.
reviews.author: Blue Horseshoe

reviews.title: Efficient but a bit noisy.
reviews.comment:
For a low profile fan it works great, looks great in the case. I used the included backplate on my motherboard not the one that came with the cooler.
It's cooling a 9700x and at stock settings in a stress test it kept the CPU temp around 70 degrees.
My only complaint is the little fan is definitely on the noisey side so I adjusted the fan curve and now when gaming it's barely audible and still keeps my CPU in the low to mid 80s, still comfortably below the 95 degree throttle temp.
reviews.author: kevin

reviews.title: This thermal paste WILL kill computers
reviews.comment:
Cooler is decent quality, the thermal paste included is enough to return the product. I have been building computers since the Pentium 2 was hot off the press. I have never seen thermal paste as useless and dangerous as the sort included with this cooler.
I typically do not use included thermal paste on my builds unless I know the cooler is coming off shortly anyways. The paste that this came with has ZERO ability to spread nor to adhere to the chip face nor the heatsink. If a less experienced system builder tried to use this they will certainly kill thier machine over time due to misapplication.
